run_visualization_demo_on_image: run VisualizationDemo on a BGR image to get predictions and visualized output
run_visualization_demo_on_video: run VisualizationDemo on a video stream to yield visualized prediction frames
create_async_predictor: create an AsyncPredictor with multiple GPU workers for parallel model inference
use_async_predictor_put_get: use AsyncPredictor put and get methods to submit images and retrieve predictions asynchronously
shutdown_async_predictor: shutdown the AsyncPredictor to stop all worker processes and clean up resources
